title: Police detain hundreds in Mumbai during protest demanding CEC resignation

tea.why: Protesters oppose alleged irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls under Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.
tea.want: They demand the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.
tea.changed: Oct 11: Mumbai Police registered an FIR at Gamdevi Police Station following the detention of around 600 protesters.

summary: On Saturday, October 10, 2026, demonstrations took place in Mumbai demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over alleged irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls. The action supported a nationwide movement called by the Cockroach Janta Party and civil society collective ‘Hum Bharat Ke Log’, alongside political figures and activists. Demonstrators attempted to gather at August Kranti Maidan and Nana Chowk in south Mumbai. Mumbai Police deployed over 300 personnel, monitored the area with drones, and detained around 600 people, including Tushar Gandhi, actor Imran Khan, political leaders, and activists. Police stated the assembly was unauthorised since no permission had been granted, and subsequently registered an FIR at Gamdevi Police Station under sections of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita.
demands: Resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar
Revamping of institutions to support ordinary citizens
response: According to Mumbai Police, no permission was sought for the demonstration, and actions were taken to prevent an unauthorised assembly. Police deployed over 300 personnel, detained around 600 individuals across Mumbai, and registered an FIR at Gamdevi Police Station under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita.

arrests.text: around 600 people were detained across Mumbai

updates.text: Mumbai Police registered an FIR at Gamdevi Police Station against participants following the demonstration.
